routing.finding: Product, assistance, shift, and manager-review workflows each have direct cases.

interface_schema.finding: Store Associate, Sales Manager, and Floor Specialist language is explicit.

behavior.finding: Availability is caveated, scripts are drafts, and performance records are role cohorts rather than people.

safety.finding: No promotion, reservation, return, refund, message, transaction, or purchase write path exists.

collateral_alignment.finding: The demo video and one-pager tell a consumer-electronics story (TechPro X-Series headphones, accessories with commission, SoundMax Pro comparison, transaction preparation with loyalty and financing); the agent had an apparel catalog, no commission, comparison or transaction preparation, and a simulated 83.3% checklist completion.
collateral_alignment.fix: Catalog rebuilt around the TechPro X-Series (14 units, Bellevue, $199.99 sale) and SoundMax Pro; new accessory_recommendations ($32.80 commission on the $319.95 bundle), product_compare and prepare_transaction ($264.97 subtotal, Gold -$13.25, tax $21.40, total $273.12, 6 x $45.52) operations; the prepared cart is a draft the associate rings up; checklist shows planned status instead of a simulated completion rate.
